segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Hello, I'm delighted to welcome you to our Wildlife Club, and very pleased that you're interested in the countryside and the plants and creatures of this area.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: I think you'll be surprised at the variety we have here, even though we're not far from London.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: I'll start by telling you about some of the parks and open spaces nearby.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: One very pleasant place is Halland Common.This has been public land for hundreds of years, and what you'll find interesting is that the River Ouse, which flows into the sea eighty kilometres away, has its source in the common.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: There's an information board about the plants and animals you can see here, and by the way, the common is accessible 24 hours a day.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Then there's Holt Island, which is noted for its great range of trees.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: In the past willows were grown here commercially for basket-making, and this ancient craft has recently been reintroduced.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The island is only open to the public from Friday to Sunday, because it's quite small, and if there were people around every day, much of the wildlife would keep away.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: From there it's just a short walk across the bridge to Longfield Country Park.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Longfield has a modern replica of a farm from over two thousand years ago.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Children's activities are often arranged there, like bread-making and face-painting.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The park is only open during daylight hours, so bear that in mind if you decide to go there.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Longfield Park has a programme of activities throughout the year, and to give you a sample, this is what's happening in the next few days.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: On Monday you can learn about herbs, and how they've been used over the centuries.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: You'll start with a four of our herb garden, practise the technique of using them as colour dyes for cloth, and listen to an illustrated talk about their about their use in cooking and medicine.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Then on Wednesday you can join local experts to discover the variety of insects and birds that appear in the evening.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: We keep to a small number of people in the group, so if you want to go you'll need to phone the park ranger a few days ahead.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: There's a small charge, which you should pay when you turn up.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: I'm sure you're all keen to help with the practical task of looking after the park, so on Saturday you can join a working party.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: You'll have a choice of all sorts of activities, from planting hedges to picking up litter, so you'll be able to change from one to another when you feel like it.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The rangers will be hard at work all day, but do come and join in, even for just a short while.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: One thing, though, is to make sure you're wearing something that you don't mind getting dirty or torn. And finally I'd like to tell you about our new wildlife area, Hinchingbrooke Park, which will be opened to the public next month.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: This slide doesn't really indicate how big it is, but anyway, you can see the two gates into the park, and the main paths.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: As you can see, there's a lake in the north west of the park, with a bird hide to the west of it, at the end of a path.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: So it'll be a nice quiet place for watching the birds on the lake.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Fairly close to where refreshments are available, there's a dog-walking area in the southern part of the park, leading off from the path.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: And if you just want to sit and relax, you can go to the flower garden; that's the circular area on the map surrounded by paths. And finally, there's a wooded area in the western section of the park, between two paths.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Okay, that's enough from me, so let's go on to...
